description: Get the Monitoring Summary for a project: the aggregate health picture across its Monitors over a period, defaulting to the last 7 days, with per-Monitor and per-day aggregates for trends (times in seconds; performance score 0-100). Drill down instead of asking for more: list_incidents for what opened and closed in the period, list_monitor_cycles for one Monitor's individual Cycles. Read the 'monitoring' topic before interpreting uptime or health for the user.

since.description: Start of the period, ISO-8601 (2026-08-19 or 2026-08-19T00:00:00Z). Defaults to seven days before until.

until.description: End of the period, ISO-8601. Defaults to now.

name: get_monitoring_summary
title: Get Monitoring Summary
